description: This is a test support class for a web application, creating an in-memory test host environment for the DataAssetBackend minimal API. It configures mocking of authentication and database dependencies for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestAppFactory
classes.description: Creates an in-memory test host for the DataAssetBackend minimal API, configuring authentication and repository dependencies for testing scenarios.

classes.name: TestAuthHandler
classes.description: A mock authentication handler that provides a test principal with all roles for authenticated endpoints during testing.

classes.name: ThrowingNpgsqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: A database connection factory that throws an exception if used, indicating the database is not configured during tests.

classes.name: ThrowingAssetRepository
classes.description: A stub repository that throws if invoked, used to keep the test host startable without a real database.

classes.name: ThrowingAssetCopyRepository
classes.description: A stub repository for AssetCopy that throws on use, for testing purposes.

classes.name: ThrowingAssetCopyLineageRepository
classes.description: A stub for AssetCopyLineageRepository that throws if invoked.

classes.name: ThrowingMasterRepository
classes.description: A stub for MasterRepository that throws on access.

classes.name: ThrowingSection4Repository
classes.description: A stub for Section4Repository that throws if used.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the WebHost configuration to set environment, configure authentication, and replace database services with stubs for testing.

methods.name: HandleAuthenticateAsync
methods.description: Provides a mock authenticated principal with multiple roles for testing authorization.

methods.name: DbNotConfigured
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating the database is not configured during testing.
